scope: Clinical evidence, causal chain, patient lineage, useful function and source-value audit. No outreach, treatment, purchased materials or new experiments.
recommendation: Affirmative development-definition and pediatric article/exposure/organ-function qualification project. Human evidence means another generic target-rescue animal or cell experiment is not automatically required; use models when they change article/window/claim selection.

article.note: Do not silently substitute the marketed tablet for the authors dosage-form wording

baseline.functional: Severe developmental delay, global hypotonia, needs help walking/feeding/dressing

clinical_records.cardiac_delta_interpretation: Reported range arithmetic gives 15–25 percentage-point improvement by 8 months; not a confidence interval, randomized effect, or normalization.
clinical_records.neurological_function: Serial reported improvements in mobility, endurance, interaction and autonomy; no complete masked standardized longitudinal effect dataset.
clinical_records.CNS_observation: MRI and lumbar puncture not performed because anesthesia required; no direct CNS exposure/PD result.
clinical_records.adverse_observations: Reported asymptomatic bilirubin elevation; total 17 micromol/L baseline, 24 at 3 months, 17–40 thereafter; other listed routine laboratories described unremarkable.
clinical_records.independence: Distinct patient in original two-person series; repeats in supplement/program publicity are the same observation.
clinical_records.claim_supported: Established severe-cardiac functional improvement associated with continued treatment and supportive care

baseline.cardiac: Normal systolic function; upper-normal LV size, noncompaction-like trabeculation and borderline diastolic function

cardiac_trajectory.context: Normal systolic/diastolic function; metoprolol starts at approximately 1 year

clinical_records.neurological_function: Reported improvement in gait/ataxia, concentration, speech/sign language and social interaction; unblinded observations.
clinical_records.CNS_observation: MRI unchanged at 12 months; no measured CNS exposure or CSF D-2-HG trajectory recovered.
clinical_records.adverse_observations: Total bilirubin 12 micromol/L baseline, 57 at 1 month, 38–58 thereafter; described asymptomatic.
clinical_records.independence: Second original individual; not a severe-baseline-cardiomyopathy responder.
clinical_records.claim_supported: Exact-disease pediatric sprinkle use and biochemical engagement

clinical_records.start_date: Not explicitly reported; diagnosis December 2019 at 3 years, initiation 3 years 11 months

article.further_reduction: twice weekly produced detectable trough urine metabolite
article.dose_form_specification: Not sufficiently defined for an independent infant formulation bridge

cointerventions: levetiracetam and oxcarbazepine in prior care

clinical_records.cardiac_function: Follow-up described normal LV size/function, QTc 430 ms; not another independently quantified severe-DCM trajectory.

developmental_assessments.limitation: Summary not fully resolved by visit/instrument; do not infer all changes at a specified visit or equate age equivalents to equal-interval scores.

clinical_records.seizures: Reported seizure-free from initiation and subsequently weaned off antiseizure medications; exact exposure/event timeline not provided.
clinical_records.acute_care: Reported reduction in admissions and emergency visits; intervals and pretreatment ED counts differ between abstract/body/discussion.

adverse_observations.timing_conflict: Peak values at 6 months in Table 1; narrative describes persistent elevation at 18 months
adverse_observations.interpretation: Improvement after frequency reduction with sustained biochemical suppression; full normalization not supported by displayed limits. No independently established exact event date.

clinical_records.independence: Age, diagnosis timing and clinical history distinguish this child from original 2023 pair.
clinical_records.claim_supported: Corroborating exact-disease biochemical and reported organ/function benefit with a real tolerability adjustment

clinical_records.baseline: Ventriculomegaly, hypotonia, developmental delay, leukodystrophy, cardiomyopathy and a 1-year rash; biopsy noncaseating granulomas; topical clobetasol/mometasone ineffective.
clinical_records.outcomes: Complete rash clearance and reduced urine D-2-HG described after enasidenib. No numeric cardiac, developmental or safety trajectory supplied.
clinical_records.independence: Separate case within skin report; cross-publication link to other patient records unresolved.
claim_not_established: independent contribution to a pooled clinical response rate

clinical_records.treatment_start_age: Not specified; manifestations described over the next year before treatment response
clinical_records.baseline: Infantile spasms, ventriculomegaly, developmental delay; recurrent febrile nodules; histiocytic infiltrate; topical triamcinolone ineffective.
clinical_records.outcomes: Normal D-2-HG and complete rash resolution after 4 months of treatment.
clinical_records.independence: Second skin case; cross-publication participant key absent.

historical_primary_questionnaire.interpretation: Original questionnaire observations inside a review. Cross-sectional, selected historical data, with possible stable/improving courses. Not a prospective untreated survival curve, current prevalence, treatment eligibility count or market estimate.

decision_relevant_deltas.finding: Full skin-case XML now read; exact doses and start ages absent. Presentation age 8 months is not treatment-start evidence.
decision_relevant_deltas.consequence: The skin observations strengthen multisystem plausibility but do not close infant article/exposure or cardiac recovery questions.

decision_relevant_deltas.finding: Gold case baseline cardiac impairment was mild/low-normal; severe numeric recovery remains principally original G23-P1.
decision_relevant_deltas.consequence: Do not advertise two independently quantified severe-DCM rescues.

decision_relevant_deltas.finding: Primary table/prose conflicts affect adverse-event timing, normalization, biochemical percentage, utilization and socialization summaries.
decision_relevant_deltas.consequence: Keep positive clinical evidence while requiring a linked prospective dataset; laboratory improvement does not establish an optimal or fully tolerated long-term schedule.

decision_relevant_deltas.finding: Historical original questionnaire distinguishes 19 phenotyped type II cases, 24 typed records and 95 all-D2HGA records.
decision_relevant_deltas.consequence: Avoid market/recruitment arithmetic based on later vague 20/80-case summaries.

decision_relevant_deltas.finding: Exact-molecule human engagement and organ observations already exist.
decision_relevant_deltas.consequence: Match the next milestone to formulation/exposure/function uncertainty rather than mechanically require the same preclinical sequence as BLU3797.

causal_assessment.target_disease_link: Strong human genotype/biochemical rationale for R140 disease; exact clinical treatment evidence here R140Q.
causal_assessment.exact_drug_engagement: Large rapid and repeatedly observed metabolite suppression in original two plus the distinct Gold case.
causal_assessment.disease_modification: Underlying biochemical lesion is altered during treatment; the severe cardiac trajectory supports possible alteration of disease course. Generalized neurological reversal, neonatal injury prevention and drug-free durability remain unproved.
causal_assessment.established_cardiac_recovery: Persuasive within-person severe trajectory, with a separately reported milder cardiac recovery; concomitant care and uncontrolled design remain.
causal_assessment.neurological_function: Clinically meaningful observations but unblinded, developmentally confounded and not a complete standardized causal effect estimate.
causal_assessment.CNS_PK_and_repair: Not demonstrated by serum/urine normalization; no exact-disease measured CNS concentration-response series recovered.
causal_assessment.durability: Benefits described under continued exposure; short interruption and dose-frequency anecdotes do not establish drug-free durability.
causal_assessment.safety: Direct pediatric observations include bilirubin elevations and suspected liver/muscle-enzyme injury; small selected reports do not quantify chronic risk.

next_proof.first_deliverable: One defined intended pediatric article, exposure/biomarker sampling specification, organ-specific longitudinal endpoint and explicit decision rule.
controls_and_analysis: Preserve supportive care and exact co-medication changes
Do not engineer evidence by withdrawing useful treatment
next_proof.advance: Interpretable reproducible delivery/exposure, sustained biochemical engagement, credible useful organ trajectory and acceptable tolerability justify confirmation; definitive clinical causality is not required before initial qualification.
next_proof.redirect: Unreliable article, reproducible harmful effective exposure, or benefit confined to a different tissue/severity/window redirects article/regimen/claim.
next_proof.stop_claim: Adequate engagement repeatedly fails on a clinically meaningful endpoint in a system capable of showing response, or no incremental development contribution can be defined.
not_required: Generic repetition of known target-mouse rescue before every clinical-development step
Complete neurological normalization to count useful improvement
